description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'CustomerServiceTest' for testing the 'CustomerService' class related to the 'Time' module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup and multiple test methods that verify customer-related operations such as saving a customer, retrieving customers based on search criteria, and getting a customer by ID.

classes.name: CustomerServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CustomerService class, focusing on customer-related data retrieval and persistence operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates a CustomerService instance, and loads fixture data for testing.

methods.name: testSaveCustomer
methods.description: Tests the saving of a Customer object, ensuring the saveCustomer method interacts correctly with the DAO.

methods.name: testGetAllCustomer
methods.description: Tests retrieving all customers based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetCustomerById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a customer by its ID.
